fieldValues.title: two disjoint, disagreeing enumerations of "the extensions" coexist, one created during the very migration meant to stop this
fieldValues.summary: srs/records/tier-2/table-27b56c53.json (a hand-authored com.semanticops.spec/table record, created 2026-09-11) and the com.semanticops.spec/extension record catalog (10 live + 1 dormant) are two independent lists of the specification's extensions. Only 7 names appear in both; the table names 4 extensions (ext:addressability, ext:protocol, ext:registry, ext:repository) with no extension record at all, and the extension catalog has 4 members (ext:slices, ext:discovery, ext:themes-l1, the dormant ext:changelog) the table omits. No check compares the two. Separately, com.semanticops.srs/extension-dependency, a relation type purpose-built for extension prerequisites, has sat status: deprecated since 2026-05-29 with zero corpus usage and zero explaining RFC or decision record.
evidence: srs/records/tier-2/table-27b56c53.json fieldValues.rows: 11 rows (Addressability, Lifecycle, Protocol, Type Inheritance, Views L1, Views L2, Cross-Field Validation, Recommended Relations, Import Tracking, Registry, Repository)

srs record list --repo srs --type com.semanticops.spec/extension: 11 records (slices, import-tracking, type-inheritance, changelog, views-l2, discovery, themes-l1, cross-field-validation, views-l1, recommended-relations, lifecycle)

srs/package/spec-authoring-core/relation-types/extension-dependency.json: status: "deprecated", createdAt 2026-05-29 (same day as the extension Type); grep across rfcs/ and srs/records/ finds zero other references

RFC-042 Revision 4 (rfcs/rfc-042-concept-tree-spine.md, srs#782/#783) retires table-27b56c53 in favor of a generated index ([R18]) and leaves extension-dependency deprecated, not revived (Alt F), flagging its deletion as Open Question 6
